protocol: One saved JPEG per EEG row per arm; use the same expanded-512 predicted object word in 'A photo of {word}.' and the same SDXL random trajectory for own, uniform and wrong.
visual: Direct pooled projected OpenCLIP ViT-H-14 LAION2B-s32B-b79K direction to base Tencent SDXL ViT-H IP-Adapter. Restore a single native image-encoder magnitude by median unnormalized H14 norm of the 32 fixed generic training images below. No per-query norm, targets or fitting to generated images.
space_check: Verify median cosine >0.95 to released training directions on these 32 non-panel images before rendering.
model: SDXL-Turbo 512x512 four Euler ancestral steps 999,749,499,249; no CFG, IP scale 1.0, per-row CUDA generator seeded 923761 + original row; JPEG quality 95 subsampling 0.

arms.own: unit(support centroid + own EEG residual) from packet
arms.uniform: unit(mean of eight predicted-class calibration images), no residual
arms.wrong: same support centroid and residual from predeclared cyclic donor in the same predicted word and fold

endpoints: Post-generation independent OpenAI CLIP-L/14, uncentered normalized cosine for strict two-original assignment among pairs with same true object, fold and correctly predicted word; compare own with uniform on all such pairs and with wrong on pairs for which both donors are the other member. Also report wider same-word pairs and distinct same-truth donor rows; report full 1854, closed12, and intra10. Ties split. Separate panels and subjects. No target photographs or true names are used during image generation.
